CO-ROUTINE keys
  COMPOUND QUERY
    LEFT-MOST SUBQUERY
      MATERIALIZE q
        SCAN 2 CONSTANT ROWS
      SCAN q
    UNION USING TEMP B-TREE
      SCAN q
      SEARCH m USING INDEX memberships_reference (kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=?)
    UNION USING TEMP B-TREE
      CO-ROUTINE x
        SCAN CONSTANT ROW
      SCAN x
SCAN keys
SEARCH l USING PRIMARY KEY (target_kind=? AND ref_id=? AND session_id=? AND lane=?)
